article.title: -거든: usos conectivos y finales
article.part: Discurso académico y conversación — 학술 담화와 회화
article.chapter: Terminaciones coloquiales y conversación avanzada — 구어 종결형과 고급 회화

claims.summary: The Korean Basic Dictionary distinguishes a connective -거든 that marks a condition (‘if/when an event is or becomes true’) from a connective that gives an example as grounds for the following content; the latter is often followed by a question.

claims.sectionKey: Usos al final de la oración
claims.summary: The dictionary records sentence-final -거든 in plain informal speech as expressing the speaker’s reason, cause, or basis for the preceding content, and notes it can also be used when boasting or exclaiming.

claims.sectionKey: Usos al final de la oración
claims.summary: The dictionary records a sentence-final use of -거든 that introduces a premise for what the speaker will continue saying.

The dictionary lists distinct connective and sentence-final uses of -거든, so the form cannot be reduced to one explanatory function; its entry separates conditional, example-grounding, reason/basis, and continuing-premise meanings.

locator.section: Headword -거든, connective senses 1–2; official dictionary lines 21–47

links.notes: Sense 1 defines the conditional connector and gives four examples. Sense 2 describes an example-grounding connector and notes that a question commonly follows.

locator.section: Headword -거든, sentence-final sense 3; official dictionary lines 49–59

links.notes: Defines the final ending as expressing the speaker’s reason, cause, or basis, labels it 두루낮춤, gives examples, and notes boasting/exclamation uses.

locator.section: Headword -거든, sentence-final sense 4; official dictionary lines 61–70

links.notes: Defines the ending as introducing a premise for ensuing discourse and gives three examples.
The reference work separately numbers the two connective senses and two sentence-final senses.
